purpose: Teach: スリップ/安部/スパイク/発光/王妃/ラケット/昆布/ノンフィクション

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、雨で、お父さん、車、スリップ、しないように、注意して、運転してたよ、安心したよ。
lines.en: Mom — Dad was really careful driving because of the rain. He didn't slip. I felt so relieved.
lines.style: Quiet, observant tone. Speaking from genuine memory, not performing. Soft delivery on the relief—it's sincere but understated. Small child's careful attention to grown-up safety.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。新しい先生、安部先生って、いう優しい方なのよ、翔くん、ご挨拶、しなさいね、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. You know, our new teacher, Abe-sensei, is a very kind person. Sho, you need to greet her properly, okay? Really, you absolutely have to.
lines.style: Warm, gentle firmness. A mother's mix of kindness and clear expectation. Not commanding, but certain. Speaking to him as someone she trusts to listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、バレーで、スパイク、決めた時、ぼく、本当に、誇りに、思ったよ、ママ、見たかった?
lines.en: Mom, when Dad landed that spike in volleyball, I was so proud of him. Did you see it?
lines.style: Eager, bright with pride. Opening attack quick and warm. Words tumble a little—he's excited to share what mattered to him. Ends with genuine curiosity, not showing off.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏祭りの飾り、発光ダイオード、たくさん、付いてたわね、翔くん、綺麗だったわね、本当に、覚えてる?
lines.en: The decorations at the summer festival had so many LED lights on them, didn't they? Sho, it was so pretty. Do you remember?
lines.style: Gentle, warm recall. Slightly wistful—she's sharing the memory and checking if he holds it too. Soft pace, inviting him to linger in the moment with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 絵本の王妃さま、本当に、美しい人だね、ママ、ぼく、お話、もう一度、読みたいよ、お願い、本当に。
lines.en: The queen in the storybook is so beautiful, isn't she? Mom, I want to read that story again. Please, I really do.
lines.style: Earnest and hopeful, with gentle insistence. He's not demanding—he's asking with the certainty of a child who knows his mother listens. Slight lift on the plea.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、ラケットで、テニス、結構、本気で、やってたって、知ってた?翔くん、お父さん、すごい。
lines.en: Did you know Dad used to play tennis seriously with a racket when he was younger? Sho, your father is amazing.
lines.style: Soft, admiring tone. She's speaking to herself as much as to him—reflecting on something she loves about his father. Warm and almost private, like sharing a secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おでんの昆布、ぼく、本当に、好きなんだよ、ママ、今度、お祖母ちゃんに、作ってもらいたいな、絶対。
lines.en: I really love the kelp in oden, Mom. Next time, I want to ask Grandma to make it. I really do.
lines.style: Simple, direct want. Quiet sincerity—not greedy, just certain about what he loves. Gentle persistence. The second 'really' is earnest, not pushy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ノンフィクションの本、お祖父ちゃんの書斎、たくさん、あるわよ、翔くん、大きくなったら、読めるわね、絶対、楽しみ。
lines.en: Your grandfather has so many non-fiction books in his study, Sho. When you grow up, you'll be able to read them. You absolutely will. I can't wait for that.
lines.style: Tender, patient certainty. Speaking into his future with quiet confidence. Warm pacing, like she's tucking a promise into his memory. No rush—just faith.
